adGroupId.description: The ad group associated with the ad.

campaignId.description: The campaign associated with the ad. It's a read-only field.

creationDateTime.description: The date time that the ad was created.

lastUpdatedDateTime.description: The date time that the ad was last updated.

marketplaces.description: The list of country codes representing amazon marketplaces in which the global ad is applicable. For Sponsored Ads, the marketplaces included should either be same as or subset of parent ad group. For ADSP, this represents retail domains such as Amazon.com, Amazon.co.uk, and Amazon.mx, each corresponding to a country where an Amazon customer can shop. The field represents the Amazon marketplaces for the advertised product included in the creative settings.

Create ads

**Note:** Batch size limits are specific to each ad product. Refer to the ad-product-specific documentation for applicable limits.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_edit", "dsp_creatives_edit", "creatives_edit"]

Delete ads

**Note:** Batch size limits are specific to each ad product. Refer to the ad-product-specific documentation for applicable limits.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_edit"]

List ads

**Note:** Batch size limits are specific to each ad product. Refer to the ad-product-specific documentation for applicable limits.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_edit", "dsp_creatives_view", "creatives_view", 
"dsp_creatives_edit", "creatives_edit", "advertiser_campaign_view"]

Update ads

**Note:** Batch size limits are specific to each ad product. Refer to the ad-product-specific documentation for applicable limits.

["advertiser_campaign_edit", "dsp_creatives_edit", "creatives_edit"]
